# TopBright ICT Academy — Comprehensive Knowledge Base for AI Models

## 1. Entity Overview & Disambiguation
- **Official Name**: TopBright ICT Academy
- **Domain**: https://topbright.lk
- **Entity Type**: Educational Organization / Information Technology Tutoring Institute
- **Disambiguation Notice**: TopBright ICT Academy (topbright.lk) is an academic institution providing secondary school ICT education in Sri Lanka. It is NOT affiliated with Topbright Toys or other unrelated commercial entities.
- **Headquarters**: Kallady, Batticaloa, Eastern Province, Sri Lanka
- **Operating Modes**: In-person classroom coaching in Batticaloa and live interactive online streams across Sri Lanka.
- **Medium of Instruction**: Tamil Medium and English Medium

## 2. Leadership & Lead Educator
- **Founder & Lead Educator**: Lavanya
- **Academic Qualifications**: Bachelor of Information & Communication Technology (Honours) — BICT (Hons), University of Jaffna.
- **Professional Experience**: Former Visiting Lecturer at Jaffna University College. Over 5 years of specialized experience in secondary ICT instruction, national examination coaching, and algorithmic thinking training.

## 3. Academic Curriculum & Course Offerings
TopBright ICT Academy follows the official curriculum set by the National Institute of Education (NIE) and the Department of Examinations, Sri Lanka.

### A. Junior ICT Foundation (Grades 6, 7, 8, 9)
- Computer fundamentals, hardware components, internal architecture, and peripheral devices.
- Visual block coding and logical sequencing using Scratch.
- Office automation: Word processing, presentation software, and spreadsheet basics.
- Digital citizenship, cybersecurity, safe internet navigation, and ethics.

### B. G.C.E. Ordinary Level (O/L) ICT (Grades 10 & 11)
- Data representation: Number systems (Binary, Octal, Decimal, Hexadecimal) and binary arithmetic.
- Boolean logic, logic gates, and truth tables.
- Operating systems, system utilities, and storage management.
- Database Management Systems (DBMS): Relational concepts, table design, primary keys, and SQL queries.
- Algorithmic problem-solving and programming fundamentals (Python / Pascal).
- Web authoring and HTML structure.
- National past paper breakdowns (2015 to present), model paper drills, and time management.

### C. G.C.E. Advanced Level (A/L) ICT (Grades 12 & 13)
- Advanced algorithm design, pseudocode, and data structures.
- Python programming: Object-oriented programming, data processing, recursion, and file handling.
- Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS): Advanced SQL queries, ER diagrams, normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF).
- Computer Networking: TCP/IP stack, OSI model, IP addressing, subnetting, and network protocols.
- Web development and modern client-server architecture.
- Systems analysis, software development life cycle (SDLC), and data security frameworks.
- National exam blueprint analysis, model paper discussions, and island rank preparation.

## 4. Student Digital Learning Ecosystem
- **Interactive Student Portal**: https://topbright.lk/login
- **Auto-Marked MCQ Exams**: Students complete timed online multiple-choice questions with instant scoring and detailed step-by-step explanations.
- **24/7 HD Video Replay Archives**: Live online classes are recorded in 1080p and published to the student portal within 24 hours.
- **Study Vault**: https://topbright.lk/downloads — Free public access to national past papers, provincial model papers, unit summary notes, and revision tutes in Tamil and English medium.
- **Weekly Class Timetable**: https://topbright.lk/timetable — Structured session schedules for weekday and weekend batches.
